stem.en: In a made-up example, a measuring pole at a port reads 13.5 m at high tide and 1.5 m at low tide on the same day. What is the tidal range, in metres?

explanation.en: Tidal range is high water minus low water: 13.5 - 1.5 = 12 m. That is about the range of the Gulf of Khambhat, one of the highest. Some other ports reach 4 to 5 m.

hints.en: Take the low reading from the high reading.
